kept.issue_no: gazette issue number within the year
kept.mk_page: page of the source PDF the Macedonian side came from
kept.sq_page: page of the source PDF the Albanian side came from
kept.is_high_quality: the extraction pipeline's own strict flag
kept.sonar_cosine: SONAR similarity; null on is_high_quality rows, never scored
kept.gale_church_inferred: the link came from length alone, not content
kept.mk_ocr_confidence: OCR score where the page was OCR'd (~4% of rows)
kept.source_pdf: source PDF object name; dictionary-encoded, near-free

deleted.slv_identifier: documented in 01_1 as NOT a stable key; publishing invites a bad join
deleted.filename: superseded by source_pdf, issue_key and issue_no
deleted.match_confidence: 01_1 documents it as mixing Hybrid scores with Gale-Church normal-tails on incomparable scales; quality_confidence supersedes it
deleted.source_object: leaks the GCS bucket path sl_vesnik_izdanija/DATA_PARQUET/...
deleted.length_ratio: min/max of the two character counts
deleted.lingua_agreement: derived from the two language verdicts
deleted.dup_key: internal sha1 of the normalised pair
deleted.dup_group_id: internal factorize() id, meaningless outside the build
deleted.dup_count: copies within the pre-filter corpus; not meaningful post-filter
deleted.split_bucket: implementation detail of the hash split
deleted.sonar_text_too_short: a length threshold on the shorter side
